description: 12 GolfPose body joints with direct MediaPipe equivalents

dropped_golfpose_body_joints.0: hip (mid-pelvis) — no single MediaPipe equivalent; would need mean(23,24)
dropped_golfpose_body_joints.7: spine — no MediaPipe landmark between hips and shoulders
dropped_golfpose_body_joints.10: head — NOSE (MP 0) is too far anterior; excluded for precision

notes: MediaPipe world landmarks: origin at mid-hip, Y increases downward (negative Y = above hip). GolfPose lab frame: Z is height (positive up), Y is front-back depth, X is left-right. Procrustes calibration on S1 recovers the 3D rotation+scale mapping from MP space to GP lab space.
